SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_delivery_mode' THEN value END) AS email_delivery_mode,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_test_recipient' THEN value END) AS email_test_recipient,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_sender_name' THEN value END) AS email_sender_name,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_reply_to' THEN value END) AS email_reply_to,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'email_signature_template_key' THEN value END) AS email_signature_template_key,
  MAX(CASE WHEN key = 'n8n_base_url' THEN value END) AS n8n_base_url
FROM public.global_settings
WHERE key IN ('email_delivery_mode', 'email_test_recipient', 'email_sender_name', 'email_reply_to', 'email_signature_template_key', 'n8n_base_url');

parameters.jsCode:
const input = $('Resolve Send Request').first()?.json ?? {};
const sqlLiteral = (value) => "'" + String(value ?? '').replace(/'/g, "''") + "'";
const replyToCaseEmailIdSql = input.reply_to_case_email_id ? sqlLiteral(input.reply_to_case_email_id) : 'NULL';
const threadReplySql = ['reply', 'reply_all'].includes(input.mode) ? 'true' : 'false';
const parentRequiredSql = ['reply', 'reply_all', 'forward'].includes(input.mode) ? 'true' : 'false';
const sql = [
  'WITH selected_case AS (',
  '  SELECT * FROM public.cases WHERE id = ' + sqlLiteral(input.case_id) + '::uuid',
  '), parent_email AS (',
  '  SELECT',
  '    ce.id,',
  '    ce.case_id,',
  '    ce.direction,',
  '    ce.subject,',
  '    ce.recipients,',
  '    ce.internet_message_id,',
  '    ce.in_reply_to_message_id,',
  '    ce.references_header,',
  '    ce.gmail_message_id,',
  '    ce.gmail_thread_id',
  '  FROM public.case_emails ce',
  '  JOIN selected_case sc ON sc.id = ce.case_id',
  '  WHERE ce.id = ' + replyToCaseEmailIdSql + '::uuid',
  '  LIMIT 1',
  ')',
  'SELECT',
  "  COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(selected_case) FROM selected_case), '{}'::jsonb) AS case_row,",
  "  COALESCE((SELECT to_jsonb(parent_email) FROM parent_email), '{}'::jsonb) AS parent_email_row,",
  '  CASE',
  "    WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM selected_case) THEN 'Case not found.'",
  "    WHEN " + parentRequiredSql + " AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parent_email) THEN 'Source email was not found for this case.'",
  "    WHEN " + threadReplySql + " AND COALESCE((SELECT internet_message_id FROM parent_email), '') = '' AND COALESCE((SELECT gmail_thread_id FROM parent_email), '') = '' THEN 'Reply email has no Message-ID or Gmail thread id to reply to.'",
  '    ELSE NULL',
  '  END AS error_message'
].join('\n');
return [{ json: { ...input, sql } }];
